facts.raw_span: A 3-year-and-9-month-old Chinese girl
Birth weight 3130g, length 50cm, and OFC 34cm
Developmental milestones were comprehensively delayed
head control at 4 months, rolling over at 7 months, unable to walk, can only briefly stand with support
Speech significantly delayed
weight 10.5kg (<3rd percentile), height 92cm (3rd-10th percentile), OFC 45cm (<3rd percentile)
Mental age evaluation at 3 years 6 months showed development equivalent to 5.7 months
History of congenital heart disease with corrective surgery at 54 days
First developed febrile seizures at age 2 years 7 months
experienced repeated right-sided epistaxis without obvious trauma, with bleeding episodes lasting 1.5 to 16 hours
Very low sloping forehead, wide nasal bridge, hypertelorism, thin upper lip, and micrognathia
Hemoglobin: Dropped from 124 g/L to 64 g/L over three months
